heroHeadline: Day 77: 'El Chucky' (CJNG Manzanillo Plaza Boss) Arrested in Bahía de Santiago Operation — 32 Days to FIFA World Cup; El Sapo at Large as Mexico's #1 CJNG Priority Target
heroSubtitle: Day 77 since El Mencho's killing at Tapalpa, Jalisco (February 22, 2026). EL CHUCKY ARRESTED — MAY 9, 2026: Federal and state forces using aerial drone surveillance arrested Lorenzo Sánchez 'El Chucky,' CJNG's plaza boss for Manzanillo, Colima, in the exclusive Bahía de Santiago area — no shots fired. El Chucky controlled CJNG's operations at the Port of Manzanillo, Mexico's busiest Pacific port and the primary entry point for Chinese fentanyl precursors. His arrest follows the April 16 arrest of eight Manzanillo police officers for leaking C5i intelligence to CJNG via Threema — a sustained two-pronged dismantlement of CJNG's Manzanillo port sector (intelligence corruption network → plaza boss leadership). DECAPITATION CAMPAIGN — 77-DAY LEDGER: El Mencho (killed Feb 22), El Tuli (killed Feb 22), El Doble R (arrested March 11), El Jardinero (arrested April 27, formally charged Altiplano), El Güero Conta (arrested April 27), El Cabo (arrested May 7), El Chucky/plaza boss (arrested May 9). Operativo Enjambre: 80+ officials detained. EL SAPO — MEXICO'S #1 CJNG TARGET: Hugo Gonzalo Mendoza Gaytán 'El Sapo' (CJNG military chief) remains at large as the Federal Security Cabinet's top-priority enforcement target (named May 3). With El Jardinero arrested and El Jardinero's Teuchitlán infrastructure dismantled (El Cabo arrested May 7), El Sapo is the last organized military faction leadership figure and the primary internal counterweight to El 03's financial consolidation. SUCCESSION BINARY: El 03 (Juan Carlos Valencia González, financial wing, confirmed CJNG leader — El País, April 6) vs. El Sapo (military wing, at large). QUINTUPLE BILATERAL PRESSURE TRACK — MAXIMUM STRESS: (1) CIA-Chihuahua sovereignty deadlock (constitutional impasse — Maru Campos declined April 28 Senate hearing); (2) DOJ SDNY indictment of Sinaloa Governor Rubén Rocha Moya + 9 officials (Rocha Moya on 'temporary leave' since May 2); (3) Sheinbaum's 'irrefutable proof' extradition standard (May 6); (4) U.S. State Dept formal review of all 53 Mexican consulates; (5) ongoing CJNG interdiction (El Chucky arrest May 9). Trump's May 7 warning ('if they're not gonna do the job, we will') represents maximum bilateral rhetorical pressure. WORLD CUP COUNTDOWN: 32 days to FIFA World Cup 2026 opening match (June 11, Mexico City). Guadalajara hosts 4 group-stage matches; Mexico's 130,000-person nationwide security deployment continues.
